tracks.title: The Inner Core
tracks.flavor: You're deep into it this time. The center of everything. The world around you thrums with energy and portent...

tracks.title: Bubbling Pools
tracks.flavor: The stench of life fills the air. Viscous fluid bubbles to the surface in great exhortations of gas and moisture. Something about these pools is familiar..

tracks.title: March of the Faithful
tracks.flavor: The devoted stream into the distance. The dust from their sandaled feet blocks out the sun for miles around. There's no stopping them. They believe.

tracks.title: Solemn Vow
tracks.flavor: When death is near, and retreat is not an option. Only the bravest have any purchase on the word "honor".

tracks.title: Desert Bazaar
tracks.flavor: Everything about this desert planet is familiar, but different at the same time. The pungent aroma of spice fills you with the thrill of adventure.

tracks.title: Abyssal Gaze
tracks.flavor: The blackness of space, the silence of the open sea, the depths of a cave. When you stare into the abyss...you know the rest.

tracks.title: The Desert Awaits
tracks.flavor: The air before you distorts in the heat. The sun has baked the world into an impenetrable crust. Nothing can survive out there for long. Yet out there is where you must go.

tracks.title: Dust to Dust
tracks.flavor: Sometimes the only sure thing is the end. Beyond the adventure, beyond the riches, beyond the fame. Everyone dies.

tracks.title: Before the Storm
tracks.flavor: Sharpen those swords, check the perimeter defences and pray to whatever gods you hold dear. Tomorrow's going to be a big day.

tracks.title: In the Shadows
tracks.flavor: This seemed like a pretty good place to hide, but now, you're not so sure. There's something familiar about this place. There's also something moving

tracks.title: Shelter from the Storm
tracks.flavor: Admittedly, it may not be the perfect spot. But it's a hell of a lot better than out there. At least it's warm and we'll get a chance to rest.

tracks.title: Disembodied Spirits
tracks.flavor: The night is alive with a thousand tiny voices. It's hard to make out what they're saying. Are they the welcoming committee? Or a warning klaxon.

tracks.title: Cave of Time
tracks.flavor: Deep underground an ancient cavern yawns before you and welcomes you, it's first visitors in a thousand years. The denizens of this place may not agree.

tracks.title: Protean Fields
tracks.flavor: A plane beyond your own, filled with darkening swirls of color and mist. A low, pulsing energy embraces your mind and dulls your thoughts.

tracks.title: Alien Machine Shop
tracks.flavor: You want the latest modifications? You want to squeeze a few more years out of those ancient matter displacers? It's gonna cost you.

tracks.title: Busy Space Port
tracks.flavor: The gleaming heart of any worthwhile planet. You can get transport here to just about any place. It's a good spot to meet a pilot, a smuggler, or your next mark. Keep your head down.

tracks.title: Alien Night Club
tracks.flavor: It's hot, crowded, and swarming with species from every corner of the galaxy. The perfect spot to blend in, fade away or meet the perfect wingman.

tracks.title: House on the Hill
tracks.flavor: You've heard the stories all your life. 50 years ago this night, an entire family killed after church one Sunday. Only one survived. 'The baby' still lives there.

tracks.title: Age of Sail
tracks.flavor: Fear not the mountainous waves and perilous winds! For who among us, will journey upon the sea and not gaze, ultimately, upon himself?

tracks.title: Dark Continent
tracks.flavor: In another timeline, in another universe, it was the ancient city-states of Africa which eclipsed Rome as a beacon of civilization, culture . . . and war.

tracks.title: Derelict Freighter
tracks.flavor: The listing hulk of a derelict space craft makes a tempting salvage target. But what happened to her crew? Something is not quite right here.

tracks.title: True West
tracks.flavor: Sometimes having a price on your head isn't enough to keep you out of town. As long as there's whisky, cards, and the possibility of a payday.

tracks.title: The Slaughtered Ox
tracks.flavor: A horn of mead, a bowl of stew and a hook to hang your 50 feet of rope, The Slaughtered Ox has been catering to the adventuring class for eons.

tracks.title: Forbidden Galaxy!
tracks.flavor: Hurtle through the cosmos! Explore unknown worlds! Face fearsome foes from beyond! Set ray-guns to ADVENTURE!

tracks.title: Deep Space EVA
tracks.flavor: The deal was simple: 4 years working on a deep space mining operation and you could return to earth a free man. That is, if you survived.

tracks.title: Uncommon Valor
tracks.flavor: Bullets buzz overhead like wasps defending a hive. One last look at the girl in the torn photo. Breathe deep, keep your head down. This is for freedom!

tracks.title: Xingu Nights
tracks.flavor: Dense, rich and verdant, the forest floor oozes with life and decay. Overhead, the canopy has hidden the sky for millennia.

tracks.title: Nephilim Labs FE
tracks.flavor: Find out more at FraggedEmpire.com

tracks.title: Kaltoran Craft FE
tracks.flavor: Find out more at FraggedEmpire.com

tracks.title: Los Vangeles 3030
tracks.flavor: Towering spires of glass, neon and steel - dense air traffic and a constant rain that never cleanses. (Apologies to the Greek.)

tracks.title: Frozen Wastes
tracks.flavor: Visibility and temperatures plummeting by the second, your only thought is survival. But in your heart you know - you've been through worse.

tracks.title: City and the City
tracks.flavor: Where else can you get a roll of toilet paper, a falafel and a bootleg DVD at 3am?

tracks.title: Far Above the World
tracks.flavor: "Here am I, floating round my tin can". Or if you prefer - "That's funny. The damage doesn't look as bad from out here."

tracks.title: Clash of Kings
tracks.flavor: Two great armies lumber toward each other like centipedes of metal, flesh and bone. The ensuing conflict fuels song, poetry and legend for centuries.

tracks.title: Swamplandia
tracks.flavor: Hot, humid and swarming with insects of every kind. You'd go around if you could, but you know the only path is through.

tracks.title: Down by the Sea
tracks.flavor: Vast expanses of sand, hypnotic surf and the cries of gulls on the wing. Now there's that small issue of getting off this island paradise alive...

tracks.title: Catacombs
tracks.flavor: Dimly lit and twisting. The passages lead deeper and deeper under the city. The skulls of heroes past look on with blank anticipation.

tracks.title: Into the Deep
tracks.flavor: If the darkness, pressure and isolation don't get you, the shadows in the trench just might. This kind of work isn't for everyone.

tracks.title: Temple of the Eye
tracks.flavor: Hooded figures gather around a gleaming eye, smoke wriggles like serpents to the ceiling. What dark energies have these voices awakened?

tracks.title: The Long Rain
tracks.flavor: "It was a hard rain, a perpetual rain, a sweating and steaming rain; it was a mizzle, a downpour, a fountain . . ." - Ray Bradbury

tracks.title: Starship Bridge
tracks.flavor: The hum of engines, the vibrations of deck plates - as familiar to you as a childhood lullaby. Order, duty and experience keeps ships in the sky.

tracks.title: Rise of the Ancients
tracks.flavor: “The oldest and strongest emotion of mankind is fear, and the oldest and strongest kind of fear is fear of the unknown” - H.P. Lovecraft

tracks.title: Dome City Center
tracks.flavor: Amid the bustle of commerce, life under the dome runs smoothly. It almost makes one forget the hostile environment beyond.

tracks.title: Victorian London
tracks.flavor: London, 1851. Streets awash in noise - Merchants, organ grinders, Hansom cabs and the ever present din of humanity. Thank god for the rain.

tracks.title: Samurai HQ
tracks.flavor: Wealthy Japanese feudal lords used Samurai as their private armies. [2 Alternate versions available for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Cathedral
tracks.flavor: Cavernous, cold and quiet. Ethereal chants and muted footsteps. Paladins welcome.

tracks.title: There be Dragons!
tracks.flavor: Wiping the last of the Kobold blood from your axe, you glare in the direction of the Cleric. "Enough of this nonsense, let's go get us a real fight!"

tracks.title: Overland with Oxen
tracks.flavor: Your party has assembled, your cart is loaded with supplies, your oxen are sturdy. Just keep your eyes peeled for trouble on the road.

tracks.title: Goblin's Cave
tracks.flavor: Journey up the winding path, follow the stream into the mouth of the cavern. Light your torches. Proceed...cautiously.

tracks.title: Super Hero!
tracks.flavor: Like a Michael Bay movie in your head. Calling all heroes. The villainous tropes are on the loose!

tracks.title: Woodland Campsite
tracks.flavor: Every adventurer needs downtime. Here's a nice spot in the woods to rest the horses and enjoy a hot meal over a fire.

tracks.title: Warehouse 13
tracks.flavor: An old cement factory on the outskirts of town. Power still works. Sort of. The perfect spot to disappear - or make things disappear.

tracks.title: Strangers on a Train
tracks.flavor: With its lush interiors, fine dining and finer passengers, the Orient Express was the most well-appointed overland transportation available.

tracks.title: Mountain Tavern
tracks.flavor: An oasis of warmth and hospitality in a harsh and unforgiving environment. Warm up in front of the fire, and share a mug of spiced wine.

tracks.title: Ice Cavern
tracks.flavor: Soaring vaults of ice echo and groan, amplifying the freezing wind and hollow noises within.

tracks.title: Medieval Town
tracks.flavor: Life inside the walls, where commerce, struggle and celebration mingle with honor, chaos and crime.

tracks.title: Colosseum
tracks.flavor: Equal parts blood sport, theater and ritual murder. The Roman gladiators entertained the populace for over 600 years.

tracks.title: Terror
tracks.flavor: There are doors you should not open. Places you should never see. Turn back... Now. Halloween 2014

tracks.title: Dinotopia
tracks.flavor: Across space and time, a verdant world has evolved without mankind. How can a planet be simultaneously peaceful and deadly?

tracks.title: Dark and Stormy
tracks.flavor: "It was a dark and stormy night, the rain fell in torrents -- except at occasional intervals when it was checked by a violent gust of wind..." E. Bulwer-Lytton

tracks.title: Orbital Platform
tracks.flavor: The massive viewports on this orbital platform allow for breathtaking views of this sectors' impressive stellar phenomena.

tracks.title: Middle Earth:Dawn
tracks.flavor: When not being overrun by filthy orcses, Middle Earth can be a beautiful place.

tracks.title: Industrial Shipyard
tracks.flavor: Massive derricks heave containers from cargo ships overhead, while all manner of human activity occurs down below.

tracks.title: Mountain Pass
tracks.flavor: A treacherous path through towering mountain peaks is the only way through. Pray your supplies don't run out, and your party stays together.

tracks.title: Dungeon I
tracks.flavor: You and your party creep along the twisting, torch-lit hallways of the abandoned mine. Pro tip: let the barbarian lead.

tracks.title: Royal Salon
tracks.flavor: The Royal Salon, France, early 18th Century: a minefield of verbal sparring, whispered plots and social combat. Tread carefully

tracks.title: Asylum
tracks.flavor: You don't belong here... You don't know how you got here... There's been a mistake...Yeah, that's what everybody says.

tracks.title: 1940's Office
tracks.flavor: "It ain't ritzy, and the pay is peanuts, but it's a decent place to get some shut-eye 'til knock-off time".

tracks.title: Forest: Night
tracks.flavor: Gentle breezes wafting through the trees overhead, the sounds of the night spill forth like jewels.

tracks.title: The Age of Steam
tracks.flavor: A long hiss from a massive locomotive blankets the platform in thick white mist while porters scurry about with baggage carts. "Tickets please!"

tracks.title: Sleeping Dragon
tracks.flavor: Coiled and half buried on a towering mound of treasure, an ancient red dragon slumbers. You should probably let it be.

tracks.title: Monster Attack!
tracks.flavor: Panic! Offshore nuclear testing has resulted in a wave of monster attacks throughout the city! Run for your lives!

tracks.title: Medieval Library
tracks.flavor: Bearded men hunch over scrolls and books, quills scratching quietly. Outside the weather turns slightly and no one notices. Shhh!

tracks.title: Zombies!
tracks.flavor: A shambling mass of former humans lurches through the snow, drawn to the scent of your flesh. Can you hold them off?

tracks.title: Docks District
tracks.flavor: The person you're supposed to meet is always somewhere in the docks district. Gather your party and venture forth!

tracks.title: Alchemist's Lab
tracks.flavor: Through the haze of bubbling flasks, cages of animals and reams of parchment, a hooded figure bends low over a table muttering strange words.

tracks.title: Abandoned Fair
tracks.flavor: Twisting arcs of rusted steel rise, wavelike, over a ruined landscape. A windblown monument to happier times.

tracks.title: Steampunk Airship
tracks.flavor: Designed by the greatest watchmaker in Olde-Town, the airship "Gulliver" will ferry you above the fray in style!

tracks.title: Medieval Battle
tracks.flavor: Two armies meet on the battlefield. Standards wave, drums pound. Steel, horses and bones clash in the fight for supremacy.

tracks.title: Blacksmith Shoppe
tracks.flavor: A blacksmith's shoppe was crucial to the life of a village. From shoeing horses to making armor and weapons. Some even yanked the odd tooth

tracks.title: 1920s Speakeasy
tracks.flavor: The joint is jumping and the gin is flowing so gussy yourself up and give the heavy at the door your password.

tracks.title: Nightmare
tracks.flavor: The darkness seethes and writhes about you as you gasp for air. Waking up is a matter of finding the right door. Halloween 2015.

tracks.title: Haunted Ramparts
tracks.flavor: "I am thy father's spirit, Doom'd for a certain term to walk the night, And for the day confined to fast in fires" - W.Shakespeare

tracks.title: Lucha Libre!
tracks.flavor: Lucha Libre, the masked, high flying spectacle, is embedded deep in the very soul of Mexican culture.

tracks.title: Sewers
tracks.flavor: Dank and teeming with the foul and pestilent denizens of darkness. Bring extra torches.

tracks.title: Dark City
tracks.flavor: A slow burn action / suspense soundtrack for dark modern settings

tracks.title: Winter Festival
tracks.flavor: Holiday celebrations in a small snowy town.

tracks.title: Lively Cafe
tracks.flavor: A cornerstone of 21st century culture, the humble coffee shop. A place to relax, read, caffinate. Come for the free wi-fi, stay for the lattes.

tracks.title: Winter Woods
tracks.flavor: Cold wind, dry branches, hardy birds. A quiet meditation on winter's tranquility, or a stark backdrop to adventure.

tracks.title: Dungeon II: Mechanical
tracks.flavor: Deep in the heart of the mountain, ancient machines groan and clank with deadly precision.

tracks.title: Elven Glade
tracks.flavor: Shrouded from human sight, elves of the forest have congregated here for centuries.

tracks.title: Skirmish
tracks.flavor: Oh, it's on. Roll for initiative...

tracks.title: Starship Medical
tracks.flavor: The combined anatomical knowledge of the known galaxy. The best medical care in the fleet.

tracks.title: Noir Procedural
tracks.flavor: A TV inspired, urban noir backdrop for intrigue and investigation.

tracks.title: Arabesque
tracks.flavor: Adrift on the sands of time, nomadic warriors celebrate a life of conquest and honor.

tracks.title: Windswept Plains
tracks.flavor: A small band of horsemen bivouac under a never ending sky.

tracks.title: City Under Siege
tracks.flavor: Pinned down. Safe for now but chaos surrounds you. Move quickly, quietly, and with purpose.

tracks.title: Lost Mine
tracks.flavor: Hidden for years and only recently discovered, your party must go on a search...for the last party.

tracks.title: Cavern of Lost Souls
tracks.flavor: A yawning, supulchral chamber filled with the departed spirits of fallen warriors.

tracks.title: Volcano
tracks.flavor: The mouth of hell itself, a smoldering vista of rock and lava. Great tongues of fire and sulphur lick a darkening sky.

tracks.title: Highway
tracks.flavor: It's nighttime, you're walking on the side of a highway and you feel like you're in a David Lynch film. What could go wrong?

tracks.title: Vampire's Castle
tracks.flavor: A sprawling gothic mansion at midnight. Centuries of art and artifacts line these halls, but beware! The Master is about. Halloween 2016

tracks.title: Testing Chamber
tracks.flavor: An empty factory floor, towering spires of self-activated machines. One way out. Yes..this is what you think it is.

tracks.title: River Town
tracks.flavor: Your journey takes you to a small, tidy village on the bank of a river. The people are kind and the tavern is warm.

tracks.title: Weirder Things
tracks.flavor: An homage to an era, and a show. With love.

tracks.title: Lunar Outpost
tracks.flavor: There has been no contact with the team at Outpost 1138 for weeks. We have dispatched a recon unit to investigate.

tracks.title: Lonesome West
tracks.flavor: Brooding skies, ominous horizons. An ode to dark westerns. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons ]

tracks.title: Carnival
tracks.flavor: It's the summer of an indiscriminate year. The carnival has come to town. Rides, cotton candy and food on sticks.

tracks.title: 747 Interior
tracks.flavor: The timeless sound of a 747 cabin in flight.

tracks.title: Wild West Saloon
tracks.flavor: The rootenest, tootenest, honky tonk this side of Deadwood.

tracks.title: Orbital Promenade
tracks.flavor: A galactic crossroads of commerce and society. The largest and most central ring of the habitat section.

tracks.title: Ethereal Plane
tracks.flavor: A radiant ocean spreads itself before you as winds of color and light whirl above.

tracks.title: Astral Plane
tracks.flavor: The realm of thought, memory and psychic energy. Where the silver cords of travelers drift on waves of pure magic.

tracks.title: Dwarven City
tracks.flavor: A towering, immense city, hewn from solid rock, where dwarves shape stone and iron into soaring monuments, and mighty weapons.

tracks.title: Antiquarian Study
tracks.flavor: A cluttered, book-filled office in a creaky old house. Rain pattering at the window, and.. someone upstairs?

tracks.title: RavenPuff Common
tracks.flavor: If you've ever been to a school for witchcraft and wizardry, you spent some time in one of these.

tracks.title: Crossroads
tracks.flavor: A dust filled, diesel tinged intersection of modernity and the past. Sit awhile.

tracks.title: Spire:The Heart
tracks.flavor: A rotting hole in reality buried at the centre of the mile-high, ancient building that is Spire.

tracks.title: Spire:Amaranth
tracks.flavor: The crystalline, frozen home of the haughty, masked, high elves that rule Spire. Lit by stolen northern lights and chilled with imported ice.

tracks.title: Spire:New Heaven
tracks.flavor: Impossibly high burial grounds where hyenas prowl the streets, and preachers and zealots singing the praises of their gods.

tracks.title: Spire:Derelictus
tracks.flavor: Destitute. A run-down sump of a place, riddled with poverty and black magic. Undercity home to the downtrodden Dark Elves.

tracks.title: Spire:The Ministry
tracks.flavor: A secret, shadowy society devoted to the forbidden worship of a goddess. Piety, devotion and ritual.

tracks.title: Spire:The Hatchery
tracks.flavor: Arachnid midwives tend to clutches of unborn with ministrations of blood. And yet, it is a safe, nurturing place.

tracks.title: Spire:The Vermissian
tracks.flavor: A massive train network where trains have never really run. Decay and unreality pervade.

tracks.title: Existential Dread
tracks.flavor: It starts as a tickle at the base of the ganglia, and spreads, slowly, into your consciousness. Happy Halloween 2017!

tracks.title: Endless Voyage
tracks.flavor: Voyager is the first human-made object to enter interstellar space, traveling "further than anyone, or anything in history."

tracks.title: Car Chase!
tracks.flavor: Big engines, big funk, big hair. Put on your shades and strap in for the ride! [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons ]

tracks.title: Waiting Time
tracks.flavor: Tick Tock, sometimes adventures need a little downtime music. Lighthearted or slightly sinister, it's up to you to decide.

tracks.title: Weirder Things: 2
tracks.flavor: The sequel, to the homage that was the first Weirder Things track. This time, with more 80s.

tracks.title: Russian Winter
tracks.flavor: "People don't notice whether it's winter or summer when they're happy" - Anton Chekhov

tracks.title: The Bog Standard
tracks.flavor: A run-of-the-mill medieval tavern. No music, just ambience. Think of it as open-mic night for your Bard.

tracks.title: Open Ocean
tracks.flavor: Adrift on the waves. No land in sight, just the way you want it. Tranquility abounds.

tracks.title: Halfling Festival
tracks.flavor: Nobody parties like halflings. Nobody.

tracks.title: Carriage Journey
tracks.flavor: A long, rainy journey in a horse drawn carriage. Plenty of time to look out the window and watch the world go by. [Alt. version for Patreon Patrons ]

tracks.title: Dark Matter
tracks.flavor: The sound of the cosmos, or an alternate dimension. Infinite and majestic.

tracks.title: Temple of Helm
tracks.flavor: May Helm protect you and absolve you of your curses and afflictions.

tracks.title: Mill Town
tracks.flavor: A busy little mill town on the banks of a river. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons ]

tracks.title: Desert Winds
tracks.flavor: With little warning, the serenity of the desert is transformed into a maelstrom of biting sand and vicious wind. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons ]

tracks.title: Sunken Temple
tracks.flavor: Lost for millenia beneath the waves, an ancient edifice holds countless mysteries. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons ]

tracks.title: Dark Future
tracks.flavor: In a not too distant future, dense enclaves of humans eke out a living amid towers of twisting metal, glass and neon.

tracks.title: Hermit Hut
tracks.flavor: An old hermit lives a quiet life of routine, alone in an isolated stone hut. But is there something more? [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Mummy's Tomb
tracks.flavor: An ancient burial chamber is uncovered after a millenium. What treasures are held within? What terrors?

tracks.title: Elegant Dinner Party
tracks.flavor: The clothing and decorum of these elite gatherings often mask the undertones of intrigue and distrust. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons ]

tracks.title: War Zone
tracks.flavor: Incessant shelling of the city below as attack helicopters drone above. [Alt. version for Patreon Patrons ]

tracks.title: Cotton Club
tracks.flavor: Harlem, 1920s. The Cotton Club was the epicenter of the African American social and artistic renaissance (contains Public Domain/1926 recordings).

tracks.title: Floating Ice Castle
tracks.flavor: Kept aloft by an ancient spell, this gleaming fortress served as protection against an enemy no one remembers.

tracks.title: Graveyard
tracks.flavor: The crooked headstones have been overgrown with vines and all manner of creatures commune in the darkness.

tracks.title: Barovian Castle
tracks.flavor: For a thousand years the castle has towered over the surrounding villages. People speak of it in hushed tones. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Lakeside Camp
tracks.flavor: A quiet spot, off the beaten track. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Loop Tales
tracks.flavor: The sounds of Scandinavian, suburban futurism. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Metropolis Fanfare
tracks.flavor: A Heroic introduction to the city of tomorrow.

tracks.title: Nostromo
tracks.flavor: While the crew prepares to emerge from hypersleep, the ship slowly awakens. Halloween 2018 [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons ]

tracks.title: Secret Garden
tracks.flavor: A quiet, magical clearing in the forest. All gentle creatures welcome. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons ]

tracks.title: Artist's Garret
tracks.flavor: In a tiny attic room, rain pattering against the window, fire in the grate, pen in hand. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Outpost 31
tracks.flavor: Antarctica, 1982. An homage to the wonderful Carpenter/Morricone Score.

tracks.title: Star Freighter
tracks.flavor: A massive interstellar vessel used for long haul cargo runs. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Field of Heroes
tracks.flavor: On the field of battle, heroes are born.

tracks.title: Waterkeep
tracks.flavor: The fabled jeweled city of the north, a hub for trade, commerce and culture. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Stables
tracks.flavor: In medieval times, horses were vital for trade, travel, and war. A well run stable was essential. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Shanghai 1930s
tracks.flavor: Known as 'The Paris of the East, the New York of the West'.Anything was possible. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Forest: Day
tracks.flavor: A breezy, dense, daytime forest setting for adventure or relaxation. You choose. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Dark Angel
tracks.flavor: A dark homage to the 90s. A great backdrop to brooding drama or full bore action.

tracks.title: Medieval Fair
tracks.flavor: An important economic event in medieval towns. Merchants and entertainers gathered from afar. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Cistern
tracks.flavor: A Castle's cistern was a functional necessity, but it could also be beautiful and mysterious. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: RMS Titanic
tracks.flavor: A postprandial stroll along the deck of the world's most luxurious ocean liner. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Quiet Cove
tracks.flavor: A calm tropical inlet for ships to lay at anchor. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Fishing Village
tracks.flavor: A busy little village on the southern shore of somewhere. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Neon Drive
tracks.flavor: Hi intensity cyberpunk action for highly modified people and cars. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: The Feywild
tracks.flavor: An echo of the Prime Material Plane, where arcane energy flows like water. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: The Underdark
tracks.flavor: A vast subeterranean network of interconnected caverns. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Cry Havoc
tracks.flavor: "Cry Havoc and let slip the dogs of war" - W. Shakespeare [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Castle Jail
tracks.flavor: A dank, horrible cell in which to ponder your life's choices. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Robotics Lab
tracks.flavor: A high tech facility for cutting edge research. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Wizard's Tower
tracks.flavor: Amidst bottles and books and beasts in their cage, toils a mighty magician, a wizard most sage. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Royal Court
tracks.flavor: In this highly structured setting, those who attend the monarch gather to plot and collude. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Barren Wastes
tracks.flavor: Desolate, dessicated and dire. What used to be lush, isn't anymore. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Tavern Music
tracks.flavor: It's midsummer night down at the "Adventurer's Arms" and the bards are all here. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Ice Throne
tracks.flavor: A frozen chamber from which to rule with an icy heart. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Cyberpunk City
tracks.flavor: The true melting pot. Language, culture and technology have merged into a single multi-faceted existence.[Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Abandoned Windmill
tracks.flavor: Lying fallow for years on a blustery hilltop, the sails still spin as a weary reminder. But of what? [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Cyberpunk Bar
tracks.flavor: A seedy place on the outskirts of the city. It's not pretty, but they probably have what you need. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Country Village
tracks.flavor: A charming, quiet little village that welcomes you no matter what. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Sea of Moving Ice
tracks.flavor: These northern waters are treacherous and cold. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Underground Lake
tracks.flavor: Deep beneath the mountain, a massive lake shimmers before you. [2 Alternate versions for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Gravity
tracks.flavor: In space, things can go wrong very quickly. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Haunted
tracks.flavor: The soundtrack to a place you really shouldn't be. Halloween 2019. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Endgame
tracks.flavor: Big, brash, pulpy. Save this for the fights you might lose. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Barovian Village
tracks.flavor: Midnight. A small, quiet, mountain village in darkest Barovia. [Alternate version for Patreon Patrons]

tracks.title: Yuletide
